extension.name: System - Opera+ Sitemap
extension.author: Jecko Development
extension.license: GNU General Public License version 2 or later
extension.description: Public XML sitemap for Joomla content and external sitemap index.

field.name: external
field.label: External sitemap paths
field.description: One verified root-relative leaf sitemap XML path per line. No remote fetching.

field.name: exclude_category
field.label: Excluded category IDs
field.description: Comma-separated IDs; descendants and articles are excluded.

field.name: extra_menu
field.label: Additional public menu IDs
field.description: Explicitly allow other component menus only after checking anonymous access and canonical URL.
